lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly four horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a checkerboard pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow below.
